data.source: InsectSound1000 official OpenAgrar ZIP, real clips, not a fallback
data.split_rule: Whole recording ids. For each species the id whose full-archive file count is closest to 15% is entirely test; the remaining id closest to 15% is entirely validation; all other ids are train. Clips are then subsampled evenly inside those ids up to 320 per species. No id is in two splits.

protocol_locked_before_test.augmentation_train_only: gaussian noise std 0.15, time roll +/-3 frames, 3-bin frequency mask
protocol_locked_before_test.ctm_loss: 0.5 * (CE at lowest-loss tick + CE at highest-certainty tick)
